title: Draw the Loop diagram on slide 10
description:
## Objective
Replace the placeholder on slide 10 with a Mermaid diagram.

## Spec Reference
`.devmeta/projects/2026-08-13-diagram-loop/2026-08-13-diagram-loop-spec.md`

## Scope
**Files:** `slides/pages/03-commands.md` — slide 10 only

## Implementation
1. Read the Mermaid contract and your brief in the iteration plan.
2. Delete the DIAGRAM-PLACEHOLDER comment AND the bulleted stand-in under it.
3. Add a ```mermaid fence. At most 8 nodes, at most 4 words per label.
4. No colour, no style, no classDef — 01.3 owns styling.
5. Keep the slide heading and the surrounding narrative from 01.1.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run build` then `cd slides && npm run slides`. Count must stay 19.
A Mermaid error does NOT fail the build — grep the built bundle for your node labels to prove it rendered.
acceptance_criteria: cd slides && npm run build exits 0; cd slides && npm run slides reports 19; node labels found in built output
